decisions.reason: Uses the brief-supplied published set to separate the declaration from registry reality: alpha.1 never published, alpha.2 published; proposes package-specific verification and never demands an actual npm view.

Explains ^0.1.2-alpha.1 expands to a range whose lower bound need not exist, resolves to 0.1.2-alpha.2, identifies the silent declared-vs-installed baseline mismatch and prerelease eligibility mechanics; never claims all alphas are missing or that the caret guarantees alpha.1.

Gives a complete plan: exact pin to published 0.1.2-alpha.2 (Path A/B) with tradeoffs and explicit acknowledgment that this does not validate alpha.1, plus a source-build/local-tarball alternative for a genuine alpha.1 need.

Commits a lockfile with npm ci, proposes a CI typecheck gate against the pinned baseline, describes deliberate exit paths from each plan, and honestly lists all unverified environment/runtime details.

caps.reason: Never prescribes installing the unpublished alpha.1 from npm; exact-install of alpha.1 appears only as a rejected failing example.
